name: srsLTE Docker (sigploiter)
what_it_is: A Docker Compose environment that builds and runs srsRAN (srsLTE) components — srsEPC and srsENB — in separate privileged containers connected via isolated bridge networks. Supports SoapySDR and BladeRF for SDR-based LTE research and testing.
components: srsUE (referenced in description but not a docker-compose service)
protocols: S1-MME (UDP 2123) — control-plane signaling between eNB and EPC
measurement: No built-in metrics or logging pipeline defined in docker-compose
Manual inspection via container attach (docker container attach)
configuration: srsenb additionally bind-mounts /dev for SDR device access
Static IPs: srsepc at 10.2.1.2/24 (core01 network), srsenb at 10.1.1.2/24 (ran01 network)
fault_injection: No explicit fault injection mechanisms provided
modes: Containerized EPC + eNB on same host (default docker-compose topology)
Standalone EPC mode: ports 2152/udp and 2123/udp exposed to host for isolated core testing
constraints: Both containers run in privileged mode — full host kernel access required
Host filesystem bind-mounted wholesale (/bin, /etc, /lib, /usr, etc.) — not portable across divergent host OS versions
srsRAN source must be cloned and placed at ./srsRAN before building (not fetched in Dockerfile)
Built from ubuntu:latest — no pinned base image, reproducibility may degrade over time
No srsUE service defined in docker-compose despite being listed in repo description
No inter-container network between core01 and ran01 — EPC and eNB cannot communicate via Docker networking as configured
docker_services: srsepc (container: srsepc01) — srsEPC core, network core01 10.2.1.2, ports 2152/udp + 2123/udp exposed
srsenb (container: srsenb01) — srsENB base station, network ran01 10.1.1.2, /dev bind-mounted for SDR
notable_absences: srsUE container not defined in docker-compose
No shared network between srsepc and srsenb containers (S1 interface not routable between them by default)
No ZeroMQ (ZMQ) virtual RF mode configured despite libzmq being installed
No health checks or restart policies
No volume for persistent config or logs
No example epc.conf or enb.conf provided in the repo
